name: MCP Cybersecurity Server
description: Enables vulnerability analysis by querying CVE data through the CIRCL API and provides professional security risk assessments for SOC and Blue Team operations. It integrates tools for searching vulnerabilities with resources like risk matrices and operational playbooks to help remediate security threats.
